title: Check Open Files
description: Show the number of open file descriptors for a process.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

PID="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$PID" || ! "$PID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 PID" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Process $PID does not exist." >&2
    exit 1
fi

COUNT=$(find "/proc/$PID/fd" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type l 2>/dev/null | wc -l)

echo "Open file descriptors for PID $PID: $COUNT"
